title: Within a decade there may be serious candidates for AI consciousness

statements.text: Within the next decade, even without human-level general intelligence, there may well be systems that are serious candidates for consciousness. Meeting the engineering challenges, such as world models, self models, recurrence, a global workspace and unified agency, gives a possible research program toward conscious AI, which Chalmers presents as a roadmap or as a list of paths to avoid, not as a recommendation.

sources.quote: we may well have systems that are serious candidates for consciousness
I’m not asserting that we should pursue this research program.
